subject.title: Support Ultra thinking for the native Codex runtime

question: Should OpenClaw accept `ultra` as a shared persisted thinking/profile/config value while only native Codex app-server profiles advertise it from live discovery?
rationale: The upstream Codex contract supports native Ultra, but widening OpenClaw config, session, catalog, and plugin-facing contracts is an API/product decision automation should not make.

options.title: Accept Shared Ultra After Docs Repair
options.body: Land the feature after adding `ultra` to provider-profile docs, keeping literal Ultra gated by native Codex discovery and downgrading stale unsupported state elsewhere.

options.title: Keep Ultra Codex-Local
options.body: Pause this branch and redesign Ultra as a native Codex-only override that does not become a shared config/session/profile value.

options.title: Require More Replay Proof
options.body: Ask for one more persisted-session proof showing Codex preserves `ultra` and a non-Codex provider downgrades it without request failure.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Ultra After Docs Repair
recommendation.body: Land the feature after adding `ultra` to provider-profile docs, keeping literal Ultra gated by native Codex discovery and downgrading stale unsupported state elsewhere.
